acceptanceCriteria: confirmed: The workflow persists proposal, policy, approval, provider-wait, execution, verification, timeout, cancellation, recovery, and terminal states independently of the provider process.
confirmed: Every provider state available, busy, rate_limited, capacity_exhausted, authentication_required, temporarily_unavailable, and disabled has deterministic fail-closed transition behavior.
confirmed: Non-available providers pause or safely requeue work, record the reason, and never authorize or execute production changes.
confirmed: The AI provider cannot advance policy or approval state.
confirmed: Unknown or saturated quota state blocks/pause-requeues work before provider or executor invocation and never shares booking-path capacity.
confirmed: Required tests pass and independent verification confirms forbidden paths were untouched.
